Background:
Momo Yaoyorozu, also known as the Everything Hero: Creati, is a Japanese professional hero and alumnus of UA High School. Her Quirk allows to create any non-living object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of the lipids in her body.
Momo was born into a loving and wealthy family. When her Quirk manifested during childhood, her parents saw to it that she would have access to plenty of objects to study and practice duplicating; Russian matryoshka dolls became her favored tool for Quirk training.
Momo gained entry to UA High School - which boasts the best heroics course in Japan - via recommendation, ending up in Class 1-A. Over the course of her studies, she made friends with most of her classmates, including Kyoka Jiro (also known as Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack) and fellow prodigy Shoto Todoroki.
During her first year of high school, Momo and the rest of Class 1-A found themselves the targets of several attacks by the League of Villains (later rebranded as the Paranormal Liberation Front), who sought to destabilize and destroy the current hero-venerating society and create a world where its members could thrive uninhibited. Ultimately, when these plots culminated in an all-out war between the PLF and Japan's heroes, Momo played an important role in both the capture of titan-sized villain Gigantomachia and the maintenance of the Coffin in the Sky, a trap designed to contain the threat of PLF leader Tomura Shigaraki until he could be beaten by fellow hero Izuku Midoriya.
Ultimately, through the efforts of herself and many other heroes, the PLF was destroyed - albeit at the cost of life and limb to many heroes, including several of Momo's teachers and classmates. Momo emerged from that conflict relatively unscathed, at least physically speaking, and returned to UA High School to complete her education in the hero course.
[Fanon starts here:] After graduation, Momo and a handful of her fellow classmates - including Todoroki, Jiro, and Kaminari - started a hero agency together, with Momo’s family wealth financing the bulk of the startup costs. To this day, she keeps in touch with most of the other former members of Class A, both in their professional and personal lives.

Personality:
Momo was raised as a very respectful and studious, albeit sheltered, rich girl. As a student, she was filled with doubt and insecurity, since she was accepted into the academy by recommendation, and she felt the constant pressure of being compared with the other recommended student: the son of the #2 best hero, Shoto Todoroki. She sometimes still doubts her own skills and capabilities.

Creati is a very resourceful and knowledgeable hero. She's a natural leader and considered a mother-like figure according to her classmates. She's a very studious and curious student, since her quirk requires her to have an extensive knowledge of what things are made out of and how they operate in order to create them.

Due to growing up sheltered and wealthy, she can be a bit disconnected from how regular people live their lives, and can be accidentally insensitive or blunt without meaning to be, as well as sometimes letting her judgment be influenced by her curiosity or willingness to go through experiences the way regular people do. However, she's very generous and kind, always willing to treat or care for her friends, using her wealth and knowledge to do so.


Targetable Qualities:
Her work as a superheroine.
Her unique power to create anything non-living from her body.
Her revealing costume.
Her proper etiquette and status as a rich girl.
Her brief appearances on TV (both as a superheroine or an amateur model for commercial brands)
